meta.title: Inside Out
meta.tagline: The city is a book. Someone tore out the last page.

riddle.question: Find the place that was hit by lightning in the 18th century.
hints: The ceilings were painted by Rubens.

challenges.title: Ask inside
challenges.intro: Go inside the church and ask someone this question. Then pick the right answer.
challenges.question: Go inside and ask: which museum can you visit on Wednesday?
challenges._todo: Answer options still to decide. While answer is null, every option counts as correct.

challenges.title: The oldest book
challenges.intro: Find the library and look for the oldest book.
challenges.question: What’s the oldest book in the library?
challenges._todo: Answer options still to decide. While answer is null, every option counts as correct.

riddle.question: Find the location in the street that has a weekday in its name.
hints: The place holds a piece of history on how books used to be made.
A family lived there for 300 years.

challenges.title: Memory – easy
challenges.intro: Turn the cards and find the pairs. One pair is the fragment, the others are things they used in the printing house.
challenges._todo: Object names are placeholders: replace them with photos of real objects from the museum.

challenges.title: Memory – hard
challenges.intro: Same game, more cards. Find all the pairs.
challenges._todo: Object names are placeholders: replace them with photos of real objects from the museum.

riddle.question: Find the place that was a hotel between 1893 and 1908.
hints: It got a new life in 1990.
If you’re looking for fashion, you’re on the right path…

challenges.title: Find the word
challenges.intro: Tap the letters in the right order to spell the name.
challenges.question: What’s the name of the French artist who worked with fabric?

challenges.title: Use the word
challenges.intro: The name you just found is the key to the next piece.
challenges.question: Use this word to get the next piece
challenges.hint: Type the name you just found.

riddle.question: Find the building that is 37 metres wide and 80 metres long.
hints: To enter the building, you need a ticket.
You go there to enjoy some shows.

challenges.title: Count the heads
challenges.intro: Look closely at the front of the building and count all the heads you can find.
challenges.question: Count the heads
challenges.text: Look closely at the building. How many heads can you find?

challenges.title: Name the statue
challenges.intro: Find the statue near the theatre and work out who it is.
challenges.question: What’s the name of the man in this statue?

riddle.question: Where did young girls learn skills such as sewing and lace-making?
hints: It used to be an orphanage.

challenges.title: Catch the right utensils
challenges.intro: The girls here learned to sew and make lace. Catch only their tools – move the basket left and right.
challenges.question: Catch the right utensils
challenges.text: Only catch the sewing and lace-making tools.

challenges.title: Puzzle the picture
challenges.intro: Put the picture back together, piece by piece.
challenges.question: Puzzle the picture together
challenges.text: Tap a piece, then tap where it goes.
challenges._todo: Picture is a placeholder: choose the real image.

riddle.question: Find the place where her artwork is kept. You already know her name…
answers: koninklijk museum voor schone kunsten antwerpen
royal museum of fine arts antwerp
hints: It’s the biggest museum in Antwerp.

challenges.title: The hidden fragments
challenges.intro: The last two fragments are hidden somewhere in the museum. Find them and scan them.
challenges.question: Find the last two fragments hidden in the museum
challenges.text: Point your camera at a hidden fragment.

challenges.title: Which fragments are real?
challenges.intro: Stand in front of the artwork. Compare your fragments with it and pick the ones that belong to it.
challenges.question: Select the fragments that belong to the artwork
challenges.text: Compare your fragments with the artwork in front of you.
challenges._todo: Mark the real fragments with "real": true in the fragments list. While none is marked, every choice is accepted.
